Priya: Starting change window 18:00-19:00 UTC for v2.3.1-hotfix canary. watch SLOs (p95, 5xx) — hold if region >0.4% 5xx or p95 >220ms.

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary started at 10% in eu-central. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/serving/canary-slos

Liam: seeing a short 502 burst in eu-central at 18:02, ~12 errors over 90s, likely proxy retries. overall 5xx 0.18% on canary.

Noah: copying proxy tail:
```
2026-03-21T18:02:07Z proxy[eu-central] WARN upstream 502 req=zz1 route=serve-gateway
2026-03-21T18:02:09Z proxy[eu-central] WARN upstream 502 req=zz2 route=serve-gateway
```

Priya: thanks. OpsBot, snapshot heatmap and pod CPU for last 10m please.

OpsBot: Snapshot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.local/canaries/4610001234/heatmap.png

Liam: kvcache miss rate ticked up concurrently; perhaps cold cache after deploy. No OOMs on pods.

Priya: decision: continue at 10% for another 5m, slow ramp tests off. If any region hits 0.4% 5xx or p95>240ms for two consecutive 5m buckets we rollback. Rollback command:
```
deploy-bot rollback --service serve-gateway --to-version v2.3.0 --reason "canary SLO breach"
```

Noah: I'll prepare a temporary regional pin for eu-central if it degrades: `routectl pin serve-gateway eu-central stable`

deploy-bot: Noted. Will pause automated ramp and alert on thresholds.

Priya: leaving note for post-release: include kvcache warming graph and proxy retry histogram. handoff to nightops in 30m. :white_check_mark:
